sentences.en: We finally decided to give him over to the police.
sentences.zh: 我们最终决定把他交给警察。

sentences.en: I finally found my way out of the confusing maze.
sentences.zh: 我终于找到了走出这个令人困惑的迷宫的方法。

sentences.en: Ted was finally able to communicate his thoughts in Japanese.
sentences.zh: 特德终于能够用日语表达他的想法。
